name: Beauty Of Joseon Sunscreen 50gm Rice + Probiotics Spf 50+ Pa++++
description:
Protect and nourish your skin with the lightweight, moisturizing sunscreen from Beauty of Joseon. Designed for all skin types, this chemical sunscreen offers powerful broad-spectrum UV protection while caring for your skin.

High-Level Sun Protection: SPF 50+ PA++++ shields your skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays, preventing sun damage and premature aging.

Nourishing Ingredients: Enriched with 69% Rice Bran Water and Grain Ferment Extract Complex, along with Vitamin B and essential minerals, to hydrate and revitalize your skin.

Lightweight & Non-Sticky: Creamy texture absorbs quickly, leaving a fresh, smooth finish without stickiness or white cast.

Safe & Gentle Formula: Contains EWG Green Grade ingredients and is free from harmful chemicals, making it safe for daily use on all skin types.

Made in Korea: Trusted Korean skincare brand known for effective and gentle formulations.

Enjoy sun protection that cares for your skin, keeping it hydrated, radiant, and healthy-looking all day.
